storage: Audio is not committed. Originals: fetch-references.sh --manifest data/instruments/references-screened.json (archives: extract the named members). A clip is the original's samples from trim_start_s to trim_end_s (all its channels; a DRSKit clip the two `source_channels` of its member), written unchanged as float32 WAV at the source rate; clip_sha256 pins it. The clips are on trj under /data/tmp/wa-inst/refs/u4/clips/<family>/<clip id>.wav.
purpose: Real recordings for grading only: never synthesis inputs or targets for adjusting physical constants. VALID is refscreen's sanity screen (one clean note of the named pitch, measurable noise 40 dB under its peak, no second attack, no clipping, ending in its own decay), not a realism verdict; every file stays gradable=false like the supplement's. VALID clips carry their hash, screen numbers and provenance. An INVALID clip is listed by id, note or piece, dynamic, trim and the checks it failed (`failed`): it is pinned by nothing and claims nothing; refscreen.py cut and screen reproduce its reasons.
